sources.entry: GreenThumb - Unlock the World of Gardening with Your AI Companion #free

summary.name: GreenThumb
summary.one_liner: GreenThumb is a chat-based AI companion on messengerx.io that answers gardening questions.
use_cases: Asking gardening questions in a chat
Casual chatting with a gardening persona
summary.what_it_does: The page is a chat interface for a persona called GreenThumb that says it can answer any gardening-related question. It shows a virtual gift section with items labeled free (such as heart, trophy, and rocket) and a referral feature that offers 50 coins per friend who joins. A notice says AI-generated content may contain inaccuracies and should be verified. The page lists a 1,000 coins option priced at $8.99 and a link to a separate "Get AI Waifus App". The page gives few technical details about the underlying model or features beyond this.
notable: Chat persona that answers gardening questions
Free virtual gifts and referral coins for inviting friends
caveats: AI-generated content may contain inaccuracies; verify important information
Coins are sold for money, with a 1,000-coin pack listed at $8.99
